title: IELTS Academic Writing Task 1: Mixed Figure – Household Recycling and Waste
prompt: The chart below shows the percentage of household waste recycled in three countries (A, B, and C) from 2005 to 2020. The table below shows the amount of household waste generated per person (in kilograms) in the same three countries in 2005, 2010, 2015, and 2020. Summarize the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟练习，所有数据与场景均为虚构，并非官方雅思试题。请先仔细阅读图表和表格，注意单位与时间范围。写作时，先概述主要趋势和对比，再分段描述具体数据。不要加入个人观点或原因分析。确保字数不少于150词。
